deposited.method: C-alpha coordinates of the asymmetric-unit polymer chain. Residues are consecutive blocks of 34, the period at which that chain sequence is identical. Each block is rigidly fit onto the next by Kabsch, then decomposed into a screw. Coordinates are rounded to 0.001 angstrom. The Kajander 2007 article PDF is not open access; these are the deposited coordinates cited by that article, not a sentence copied from the PDF.
notes: Rise, twist, and radius are a screw fit to deposited C-alpha coordinates from PDB 2AVP, 2HYZ, and 2FO7. DOI 10.1107/S0907444907024353. The article PDF was not open, so no sentence was copied from it.
The asymmetric unit holds 2 or 4 repeats, not a full eight-repeat superhelix. The step is the transform between consecutive 34-residue blocks in that chain.
Sample standard deviations divide by n-1. They are the scatter of 7 steps, not a standard error printed in the paper.

No persistence length is in this coordinate table. The open abstract of Synakewicz et al. 2022, ACS Nano, DOI 10.1021/acsnano.1c09162, also does not state one. The 15 nm cutoff stays a project cutoff.
The runtime scaffold radius is the mean repeat-centroid radius. Payload clash uses the placed C-alpha trace, not a cylinder of this radius.

The runtime docking radius is the mean radial distance of the inter-repeat junction: the midpoint of C-alpha 34 and C-alpha 1 of the next 34-residue block. In these entries that junction follows DPRS. The previous 0.35 nm loop offset is not used.
Near-end lists use twice the (GGGGS)3 RMS as a comparison, not a wet-lab reach.
SpyCatcher, flx, and LgBiT lengths are not in these chords.

reading: n = 3 is a rigid screw. Contour is 2.525 nm, at or under the 15 nm project cutoff.
The end chord (repeat 0 to 2) is 24.27 Å (95% band 22.1–26.5 Å). The helical bow is 7.44 Å (30.6% of the chord).

Screw phase from repeat 0 to repeat 2 is 90.0° (90.0° modulo 360). Facing cosine is 0.000, equal to cos of that phase. Repeat index 8 is the first same-face return (Δi = 8, 360°). That repeat is not on this scaffold.
On this length, at least one repeat sits within the (GGGGS)3 comparison window of both ends.
Passing this prediction is not scientific validation. calibrated stays false.

notes: Measured block is the CTPR screw only.
FL, rigid spacers, SpyCatcher, flx, and LgBiT have no lengths in this run.
One m13 graft was requested. The repeat index was not supplied, so every m13_graft flag is false.
End-junction chord is repeat 0 to repeat n-1. It is not a SpyCatcher-to-LgBiT distance.
Wiki figures from this tool are computational screw measurements.
Do not caption them as crystal structures of the fusion.
